name: reorder-readback
title: Reorder Readback
description: Sortable list that announces each move with its meaning ("Moved Razorpay from 3rd to 1st. It's now tried first.") and Undo. Drags only from the grip, refuses to displace pinned rows, marks rows moved since save, and offers click, arrow and keyboard moves.

meta.summary: Reads back every reorder with its consequence and an Undo, so a slipped drag doesn't silently change priorities, fallbacks or steps.
catches: Every move, read back with what the new position means
Moves that would push a pinned row aside, refused with a reason
Rows moved since the last saved baseline
Touch scrolling that would start a drag (drag only from the grip)
limits: Consequence text comes from your describePosition; without it only positions are read back
Does not save; persist the order yourself (normalizeOrder in reorder.ts can run on the server)
a11y: Space picks up, arrow keys move, Space drops and Escape cancels; instructions linked via aria-describedby
Move-up/down buttons on every row give a non-drag alternative (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.7)
One role=status region with debounced announcements
Grip has an aria-label and aria-pressed; pinned rows use aria-disabled with a lock icon
Animations respect reduced motion; focus returns to the grip after moves and undo
